gate_relation.contribution: Confirms the repository-level Promotion Control denies promotion when the independent approval predicate is unmet. It does not by itself prove that GitHub provider ruleset enforcement makes this check mandatory for merge or rejects a bypass/direct push.

F_ok: A live PR event exercised the zero-independent-approval path and Promotion Control denied promotion exactly as the internal policy requires.
F_gap: The active GitHub ruleset still does not visibly require this check, and a provider-side rejected merge/direct-push receipt is still missing.
F_next: Bind Promotion Control as a required provider rule, retain the one-independent-approval policy, then attempt the provider merge/direct-push negative paths and append their rejection receipts.
